svg.title: Zonogy on two displays. Each display keeps its own tiling zones. Minimizing a window, on either display, leaves its zone empty with the Launcher open there to pick a window for it. Dragging a specific window from the menu over its Dock icon onto any zone, on either display, replaces the window there.
svg.text: Minimizing a window opens the Launcher in that zone to fill it
Or hover over a Dock icon and drag a specific window
